verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line on the Iceberg tables doc page saying BigQuery offers 'time travel for historical data access.' This confirms some first-party ability to query past data, but it gives no detail on syntax or retention window, and may only apply to Iceberg tables. Nothing in the evidence covers restoring dropped or corrupted tables from history. Missing for 10: documented point-in-time query syntax and retention window, restore of dropped/corrupted tables (undrop, snapshots, fail-safe), confirmation that it applies to standard tables, independent or hands-on corroboration.
